projects.title: Weld line inspection system
projects.summary: One dashboard for weld defects, coating defects and flange dimensions, served from a FastAPI backend.
projects.problem: Weld, coating and dimension checks were separate manual steps. Inspectors needed one place to run them on images or a live camera and export a record.
approach: YOLOv8 detector for weld defects (porosity, spatter, undercut, lack of fusion, burn-through)
Second detector for coating defects such as orange peel
ArUco marker for real-world scale, plus monocular depth estimation, to measure flange OD/ID, bolt circle and holes against a standard table
FastAPI service with a browser dashboard: upload, live camera, annotated downloads, CSV/Excel export
projects.result: Working prototype demonstrated end to end on images and live camera input, with per-defect results and exportable reports. Code and a recorded walkthrough are in the repository.

media.caption: Weld bead with flagged findings, drawn in the site style. (Illustration)

projects.title: Weld defect detection
projects.summary: Finds porosity, undercut and lack of fusion on weld seams and returns boxes through an API.
projects.problem: Visual weld inspection is slow and inconsistent between inspectors, and small pores are easy to miss.
approach: Annotated weld images for porosity, spatter, undercut, lack of fusion and good welds
Trained a custom YOLOv8 model with augmentation
FastAPI endpoint returns boxes, labels and confidences for any uploaded image
projects.result: About 90% mAP on the project validation set, as reported in the repository.

media.caption: Model output on weld samples from the project repository: porosity, lack of fusion, undercut.

projects.title: Flange and disk dimension check
projects.summary: Measures a part with one camera and an ArUco marker, then checks it against tolerance.
projects.problem: Checking flange and disk dimensions with calipers is slow and does not leave a record.
approach: ArUco marker of known size gives a mm-per-pixel scale for the frame
Contour and circle detection for outer/inner diameter, bolt circle and hole count
Values compared with a tolerance table to return PASS or FAIL
Depth-estimation variant tested for tilted camera angles
projects.result: Working measurement demo on real parts (see video). PASS/FAIL against a tolerance table in the full system.

media.caption: Live measurement: the ArUco marker sets scale (mm per pixel); outer and inner diameters are read off the part.

projects.title: Paint surface defect detection
projects.summary: Flags peeling paint, pin holes, stains and rough areas so inspectors go straight to problem spots.
projects.problem: Surface inspection of painted walls and panels relies on someone walking the whole area.
approach: Annotated classes: stain marks, pin holes, rough/pitted surface, peeling paint
YOLO detector trained on the annotated set
Runs on images and video
projects.result: Detects all four classes on test images; dense small defects such as pin holes are picked out individually.

media.caption: Model output from the project: peeling paint (0.94) and dense pin-hole detection.

projects.title: HR recruitment and onboarding workflow
projects.summary: An LLM workflow that takes applications through screening, shortlisting and onboarding.
projects.problem: Recruiters spend most of their time reading applications and moving candidates between steps by hand.
approach: Parse applications into structured candidate profiles

Hand accepted candidates into an onboarding checklist

media.caption: Pipeline as designed: applications in, screening against criteria, shortlist, onboarding. (Illustration)

projects.title: Tomato ripeness grading
projects.summary: Grades each tomato on the vine as ripe, turning or unripe in real time.
projects.problem: Harvest planning needs to know how much fruit is ripe now and how much is close.
approach: YOLOv8 tomato model with three ripeness classes
ByteTrack keeps one ID per fruit so counts do not double
Class-aware duplicate suppression
projects.result: Runs at roughly 75–85 ms per frame on CPU on real footage.

media.caption: Real-time ripeness grading on greenhouse footage. Open YOLOv8 tomato model on CPU; boxes from the actual run.

projects.title: AI-driven smart farming system (IEEE Access)
projects.summary: Final-year project: soil analysis, irrigation advice and crop-fertilizer recommendations, published in IEEE Access.
projects.problem: Farmers lack personalised, data-driven advice on soil health, irrigation and which crop and fertilizer to use.
approach: IoT soil sensors (moisture, temperature, NPK) plus a weather API
Transformer-based tabular learning (TTL) for irrigation advice
TabNet with explainable-AI for soil analysis and fertilizer; SwiFT transformer for crop recommendation
Web app with a chatbot for farmers
projects.result: Reported in the paper: irrigation advice 99.13% accuracy, crop recommendation 98.75%, fertilizer recommendation 99.3%, soil analysis R² 0.987.

media.caption: System overview with the accuracies reported in the paper. (Illustration)

projects.title: Potato leaf disease CNN
projects.summary: Classifies potato leaves as early blight, late blight or healthy.
projects.problem: Blight spreads quickly; early identification from a phone photo helps growers act in time.
approach: Leaf image dataset with three classes
Preprocessing and augmentation
Convolutional network in TensorFlow/Keras
Evaluation on held-out images
projects.result: Validation accuracy above 95% by the final epochs (see training curves); correct, high-confidence predictions on held-out leaves.

media.caption: Predictions on held-out leaves, with true labels. From the project notebook.
